dashboard.label: Remote Access and Lateral Movement Investigation
dashboard.description: SOC lab investigation, 27–28 October 2026. Times are UTC. RDP, share access, transfer and remote script execution are compared.

panel.title: R10: transferred script executed through WinRM

html.p: A 313-byte script was copied from SOC-WS01 to SOC-SRV01, then executed as SOC\lab.ops. The resulting JSON identified SOC-SRV01, lab.ops and PID 560. This was a controlled lateral movement emulation with a harmless payload.
Internal alert triggered: 28 October 2026, 14:24:00 UTC. Source TCP connections, target process GUIDs and original event records support the execution chain.

search.query: index=lab_windows host=SOC-SRV01 EventCode=1 earliest="10/28/2026:14:22:00" latest="10/28/2026:14:24:00" ParentImage="*wsmprovhost.exe" Image="*powershell.exe" CommandLine="*-File*" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | table UtcTime User ProcessId ParentImage EventRecordID
